0.0: It's so hot! Everybody across Maple World is going to be looking for ways to cool off and the monsters took all our refreshments! #h0#, you've got to get back all the cold, cold goodies before we melt!

yes.0: Hunt monsters to obtain #bIce Chests#k, which contain all our icy goodies. Open one each day for 8 days to complete the event.
yes.1: But you'll start getting rewards on day 3. So what are you waiting for? The event ends on  #b09/11/12#k, so get cracking!
